Nivel de vechime: Asociat

Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 DB Global Technology, Deutsche Bank's technology center in Central and Eastern Europe, opened its Bucharest office in January 2014 and is continuously expanding. The team comprises enthusiastic professionals working in an international environment, dedicated to learning new technologies and fundamentally changing how Deutsche Bank operates.
We're looking for a talented and motivated Backend Engineer with Spring Security hands on experience.
 What You’ll Be Doing
Work together with our highly skilled international development teams to build and maintain features of our Applications and Systems 
Ensure proper performance and quality of the written code and continuously participate in code reviews 
Write unit tests for robustness, edge cases and general reliability 
Write code in compliance with our coding standards and security mechanisms 
Continuously collaborate with cross-functional teams, product owners, designers and QA team in an agile environment 
Participate in developer guilds and enjoy learning/sharing knowledge with the team
Take on the role of a technical forward thinker and take part in the support and training of junior developer 
 What We’re Looking For
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in enterprise software development 
Extensive Java and Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, and Spring Cloud, ...) experience
Spring Security hands on experience
Deep JPA & Hibernate expertise with strong SQL knowledge
Proven hands-on experience with GCP (Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, etc.)
Experience with building and consuming RESTful APIs
Solid understanding of software design patterns and architectural principles
